name: cl.comercioia.shopping.tax_document
title: Chilean Tax Document (boleta / factura)
description: OPEN PROPOSAL, ready to implement and open for comment. Not yet stable: fields may change before the first stable release. Lets the buyer choose a boleta or a factura at checkout and returns the SII electronic tax documents (DTE) issued for the order. Amounts are integer CLP (CLP has no minor unit). Spec: https://comercioia.cl/spec/#tax-document

rut.description: Chilean taxpayer ID (RUT) without dots, with a hyphen and the modulo 11 check digit, e.g. 76123456-0. Receivers MUST validate the check digit.

document_type.description: SII DTE type code: 33 factura electrónica, 34 factura exenta, 39 boleta electrónica, 41 boleta exenta, 52 guía de despacho, 56 nota de débito, 61 nota de crédito.

receiver.description: Factura receiver. Required when document_choice is 'factura'. Lengths follow the SII DTE format.

giro.description: Receiver's line of business as registered with the SII.

tax_document_request.description: The buyer's choice of tax document. When absent, the business issues a boleta.

document_choice.description: 'boleta' for consumers (default) or 'factura' for VAT-registered buyers. Businesses MUST treat unknown values as 'boleta' and say so in messages[].

issued_document.description: An SII electronic tax document issued for the order.

receiver_rut.description: 66666666-6 for a boleta to an unidentified consumer.

total.description: Total in integer CLP, VAT included.

sii_status.description: Latest known SII status of the document.

representation_url.description: https link to a printable representation (PDF or HTML) the buyer can keep.

dev.ucp.shopping.checkout.title: Checkout with Chilean tax document
dev.ucp.shopping.checkout.description: Checkout extended with the buyer's boleta or factura choice.

dev.ucp.shopping.order.title: Order with Chilean tax documents
dev.ucp.shopping.order.description: Order extended with the SII documents issued for it.

tax_documents.description: SII documents issued for this order, in issue order.
